name: Let Us Brew an AI Model — release manifest
description: Canonical single release record: tag, tag-target commit, PDF build commit, PDF sha256, and the SHA-256 of ALL SEVEN tokenizer files under artifacts/tokenizer/. Asserted by scripts/verify_release.py (phase D) against git, the built PDF, and the files on disk — including a check that the pin list below is exactly the set of tokenizer files the book cites, so an unpinned tokenizer cannot pass the gate. The tokenizer hashes are the SHA-256 of each tokenizer FILE ON DISK (the reproducible identifier the book cites); run manifests additionally record each tokenizer's in-memory vocabulary hash, which is a different quantity.

reproduction_from_a_clean_clone.structure: Two commits, two roles. The tag v20261001 (tag_target_commit a45a881158ed076f615f6d3bc2e72640dc5cdced) is the experiment-data snapshot whose manifests and manuscript state the book's numbers cite; the scored dataset files are gitignored and regenerable with python scripts/generate_data.py — they ship in no commit (see the datasets block below). The release gate (scripts/verify_release.py) and the corrected run scripts live at the PDF build commit (this file's pdf_build_commit field) and later — the tag predates the verifier, so a checkout of the tag alone CANNOT run the release gate.
